implemented_capabilities: Created a Vite React TypeScript frontend scaffold under frontend/ with /api proxy to http://localhost:8080.
Implemented a practical PC admin console as the first screen with left navigation for suppliers, categories, products, purchase inbound, sales outbound, inventory, and slow-moving report.
Added typed API client modules for supplier, category, product, purchase, sales, inventory movement, and slow-moving report endpoints.
Added shared DTO types matching backend response/request shapes, including PageResponse and global API error response handling.
Added reusable table, pagination, modal, form field/select, page header, and status badge components.
Supplier CRUD page supports paginated keyword/status query, create, edit, loading, empty, error states, and validation for required name, max lengths, status, and phone format.
Category CRUD page supports paginated keyword/status query, create, edit, loading, empty, error states, and validation for required name and max lengths.

Product CRUD page supports paginated keyword/category/status query, create, edit, loading, empty, error states, category lookup, and validation for required category/code/name/unit, max lengths, positive shelf life, and non-negative suggested sale price.

Purchase inbound page supports paginated order number/supplier/date range query using backend fromDate/toDate params, create, edit via detail fetch, line-item editing, totals display, and validation for required order number/supplier/date, past-or-present date, at least one item, positive quantity, and non-negative unit cost.

Sales outbound page supports paginated order number/customer/date range query using backend fromDate/toDate params, create, edit via detail fetch, line-item editing, totals display, and validation for required order number/date, past-or-present date, customer max length, at least one item, positive quantity, and non-negative unit price.
Inventory page is read-only and supports paginated keyword/category query plus a read-only stock movement ledger modal.
Slow-moving report page is read-only and supports paginated keyword/category/days query.
Added restrained work-focused CSS with stable tables, toolbars, forms, modals, pagination, and desktop-width layout.
